summons.name: Weapon Gacha
summons.rule:
1. Cost Rules: Players can consume Weapon Gacha Coins or Diamonds to summon. The system will prioritize deducting Weapon Gacha Coins.

2. Resource Acquisition: Weapon Gacha Coins can be obtained through Adventure Idle and the Weapon Resource Secret Realm.

3. Level Growth: Accumulate a certain number of Weapon Draws to increase Draw Level. As Draw Level increases, the chance of obtaining higher-grade weapons increases accordingly.

summons.name: Pet Gacha
summons.rule:
1. Usage Rules: Players can use Pet Gacha Tokens or Diamonds to summon. The system will prioritize using Pet Gacha Tokens.

2. Level Growth: Accumulate a certain number of pet gacha pulls to increase your Gacha Level. As your Gacha Level rises, the chance of obtaining higher-tier pets will also increase.

summons.name: Elite Summon
summons.rule:
1. Categories & Sources: Equipment is divided into two main categories: Armor and Accessory. Armor is mainly obtained through Elite Summon, while Accessories are earned by participating in Dungeon gameplay.

2. Summon Growth Mechanics: Players can obtain large quantities of various armor pieces via Elite Summon. As your Elite Summon level increases, the quality of equipment dropped by defeated targets will also increase.

3. Inventory Management: The equipment inventory has a cap of 200 slots. When the inventory is full, the Elite Summon function will be temporarily locked. Players need to clear redundant equipment to restore functionality.

4. Dismantling & Resource Loop: Players can use the Auto-Dismantle setting to quickly process useless equipment. Dismantling equipment yields Echo Cores, which are the core material for raising the Elite Summon level.

summons.name: Normal Wish
summons.rule:
1. Prize Pool & Rewards: Collection Equipment Wish is divided into Normal Pool and Job Pool, both permanently available. The Normal Pool allows drawing universal Collection Equipment and obtaining Job Wish Tickets; the Job Pool is divided by class, allowing drawing exclusive Collection Equipment for the corresponding class.

2. Drawing Method: The Normal Pool prioritizes consuming [Collection Equipment Wish Tickets], while the Job Pool requires consuming [Collection Equipment Job Wish Tickets]. Wish Tickets can be purchased in the Mall. The specific contents of the prize pools can be viewed in Reward Preview.

3. Progress Rewards: Each draw accumulates Draw Progress for the corresponding prize pool. Progress is tracked separately for the Normal Pool and Job Pool, with all Job Pools sharing unified progress. Reach the specified number of draws to claim rewards. Progress rewards can be obtained repeatedly, including rewards for Selectable Legendary Collection Equipment.

summons.name: Heroic Relic Vault (period 1)
summons.rule:
1. Event Info: Heroic Relic Vault is a limited-time event. During the event, enter from the event panel on the left side of the main screen.

2. Draw Cost: Draws prioritize consuming Heroic Relic Keys; when insufficient, Star Stone is consumed instead. Single Summon also has a daily free attempt.

3. Pity Info: Each draw accumulates Heroic Blessing. The higher the Blessing, the greater the chance to trigger the grand prize; at max, the grand prize is guaranteed, after which the Blessing resets to zero.

4. Cumulative Rewards: When the number of draws in the current period reaches specified milestones, claim Cumulative Draw Rewards. Cumulative progress is only valid within the current period and resets when a new period begins.

5. Vault & Gift Pack: Heroic Insignia obtained from draws can be exchanged for desired items in the Heroic Vault; draw items can be purchased in Gift Pack.

6. Pool Preview: Pool groupings and appearance probabilities for each group can be viewed in Pool Overview.

7. Cross-Period Retention: Heroic Relic Keys and Heroic Insignia are retained across periods. Heroic Blessing will continue to be retained in subsequent events per this theme's rules. The Vault and Gift Pack's period purchase limits and cumulative draw progress reset when a new period begins. When the event ends, achieved but unclaimed Cumulative Rewards will be sent via mail.

summons.name: Watch & Spin
summons.rule:
1. Draw Method: During the event, you can get a free draw attempt each day. After watching an ad, you can spin the wheel with no other cost; players who own the Lifetime Card can skip ads and draw directly. Daily attempts reset the next day.

2. Wheel Rewards: Each draw randomly grants one item from the current wheel rewards. The pool uses pure probability with no pity system.

3. Progress Rewards: Reach the specified cumulative draw count to claim the corresponding Progress Rewards. Each Progress Reward can only be claimed once per event period; progress resets when the event ends, and unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail.
